body:
## What this transfer is

This Tiqets product (`p1111030`) bundles roundtrip coach transfers on the **Magical Shuttle** between Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) and **Disneyland Paris** (stopping at Chessy Marne-la-Vallée Bus Station, 77700 Marne-la-Vallée). It provides a direct motorcoach link between CDG and the theme park resort without transferring through central Paris RER stations.

## What is included

Based on the Tiqets listing verified on 29 October 2026, the roundtrip package includes:

- **Outbound transfer:** One-way Magical Shuttle coach transfer from Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) to Disneyland Paris.
- **Return transfer:** One-way Magical Shuttle coach transfer from Disneyland Paris (Chessy Marne-la-Vallée Bus Station) back to Charles de Gaulle Airport.
- **Onboard amenities:** Air-conditioned coach seating, complimentary onboard WiFi, an onboard media system, and staff assistance at boarding.

## Schedule, duration, and price

The journey between Charles de Gaulle Airport and Disneyland Paris takes approximately **60 minutes** each way. According to the listing description, coaches depart **every 45 minutes between 09:00 and 19:45 daily**. When checked on 29 October 2026, the roundtrip fare started at **€48.00**.

## What to check before booking

Because Magical Shuttle buses operate between **09:00 and 19:45**, travelers landing on late-evening flights after 19:45 or departing on early-morning flights before 09:00 will need an alternative transfer (such as TGV high-speed rail from CDG Terminal 2 or a private car transfer). Check your arrival terminal and return departure time before purchasing.
